# make_percolation_clusters_trace { #mofography.movies.make_percolation_clusters_trace }

```python
movies.make_percolation_clusters_trace(
    percolation_history,
    distance_grid,
    regions,
    atoms,
    probe_radius=None,
    isovalue=1.6,
    cscale=None,
    style='surface',
    trace_id='percolation_clusters',
    cluster_opacity=1.0,
    step_size=1,
    taubin_smooth=False,
    taubin_iterations=10,
    taubin_lambda=0.5,
    taubin_nu=-0.53,
)
```

Build Three.js mesh traces for percolated clusters at a given probe radius.
